## Our Breeding Values


Every puppy raised with professionalism, health-minded care, and personal guidance — so you can welcome your new companion with complete confidence.











### Home-Raised Puppies


Our Chihuahua puppies are nurtured in a warm family environment, not a kennel. They grow up surrounded by daily life, gentle handling, and the sounds of a loving home — building confident, well-socialized companions ready for their forever families.









### Attentive Early Care


From the first breath, each puppy receives meticulous health monitoring, premium nutrition, and early neurological stimulation. We partner with trusted veterinarians to ensure every Chihuahua leaves us with a clean bill of health and a strong start in life.









### Thoughtful Placement


We don't just sell puppies — we match companions. Through personal conversations, we learn about your lifestyle and expectations to ensure each Chihuahua puppy finds the perfect loving home. Our guidance continues long after you take your new family member home.




















## Meet Our Available Chihuahua Puppies


Each puppy is raised with love and ready to bring endless cuddles and joy into your home. We focus on temperament and health, ensuring your new companion is a perfect fit for your family.

# Your Future Companion Awaits


At Alexia Phipps, we believe every Chihuahua puppy deserves a loving, forever home. Our adoption process is personal—designed to match the right puppy with the right family through direct, caring conversation.








## How Our Adoption Works


Puppy availability changes as litters grow and families connect with their new companions. Instead of a traditional shopping cart, we invite you to reach out directly. This ensures every placement is thoughtful and every question is answered.


When you inquire about a puppy, you'll speak with Alexia personally. We'll discuss temperament, health records, and what to expect when bringing a tiny Chihuahua into your home. There's no pressure—just a shared love for the breed and a commitment to responsible placement.


Expect a warm, informative conversation. We'll guide you through our care standards, vaccination schedules, and the transition process so your new puppy settles in comfortably from day one.

Start Your Inquiry

## Frequently Asked Questions


Everything you need to know before welcoming a Chihuahua puppy into your home





### What information should I include when reaching out?


To help us match you with the perfect companion, please share a little about your household, daily routine, and experience with small breeds. Let us know if you have other pets, children, or specific preferences for coat color or temperament. The more we know, the better we can guide you toward the right Chihuahua puppy.




### When will the puppies be ready to go to their new homes?


Our Chihuahua puppies stay with their mother until they are at least eight to ten weeks old, ensuring they receive proper socialization and nourishment during those critical early weeks. We will keep you updated on developmental milestones and confirm a go-home date as the litter matures.




### What kind of home environment do Chihuahua puppies need?


Chihuahuas thrive in calm, affectionate homes where they are treated as part of the family. They adapt well to apartment living but appreciate a secure outdoor space for supervised play. Because of their small size, homes with gentle handling practices and awareness of tiny paws underfoot are ideal.




### What health checks do the puppies receive before adoption?


Every puppy receives a thorough veterinary examination, age-appropriate vaccinations, and regular deworming. We monitor for common small-breed concerns such as patellar luxation and dental development, and we provide a written health record so you can continue care seamlessly with your own veterinarian.




### What is included when I adopt a Chihuahua puppy?


Your puppy will come with a starter kit that includes a small bag of their current food, a familiar blanket with their littermates' scent, vaccination records, and our care guide covering feeding, grooming, and early training tips for Chihuahua puppy sales. We also remain available for questions long after you take your puppy home.




### What are the next steps after I submit an inquiry?


Once we receive your message, we will reply within 24 to 48 hours to schedule a relaxed phone conversation. This gives us a chance to learn about each other, answer your questions, and discuss available or upcoming litters. If it feels like a good fit, we will arrange a visit or video call so you can meet the puppies.

# Alexia's Story


With over a decade of experience in professional Chihuahua breeding, Alexia Phipps has dedicated her life to raising healthy, well-socialized puppies in a nurturing home environment. Her journey began with a deep love for this spirited breed and a commitment to ethical breeding practices that prioritize temperament and health above all else.


Every Chihuahua puppy available for adoption is raised underfoot in Alexia's family home, surrounded by gentle handling, early neurological stimulation, and plenty of affection. This approach ensures each puppy transitions smoothly into their new family, carrying with them the confidence and warmth that only a caring start can provide. Alexia personally oversees every aspect of care—from nutrition to socialization—so that when you welcome one of her puppies, you're welcoming a well-loved companion.

Get in Touch







## Our Standards & Care


Every puppy raised with love, integrity, and the highest ethical standards.










### Ethical Breeding Standards


We adhere to rigorous health and genetic screening protocols to ensure every Chihuahua puppy is born with the best possible start in life. Our breeding program prioritises temperament, longevity, and conformation, following guidelines that exceed standard kennel club requirements. This commitment to quality in chihuahua puppy sales means you bring home a companion bred with care, not volume.










### Gentle Socialisation Approach


From the moment they open their eyes, our puppies are handled with patience and kindness. They are raised in a warm home environment, exposed to everyday household sounds, gentle children, and other pets. This early socialisation builds confident, well-adjusted companions who transition smoothly into their forever families, reflecting our belief that a well-raised chihuahua yorkie mix puppy or purebred deserves the gentlest start.










### Cleanliness & Care Commitment


Our nursery and play areas are maintained to immaculate standards, with daily cleaning routines, fresh bedding, and regular veterinary check-ups. We believe a healthy environment is the foundation of a healthy puppy. Prospective families are welcome to see our setup and witness first-hand the dedication that goes into raising great pyrenees puppies and our tiny Chihuahua treasures alike, ensuring complete transparency in our care practices.












## Why Choose Alexia Phipps


A breeder dedicated to the health, happiness, and lifelong well‑being of every Chihuahua puppy.








### Personal Communication


Direct, honest conversations from the very first inquiry. Alexia takes the time to understand your home, your routine, and your expectations so she can match you with the perfect companion.







### Intimate Home‑Raised Care


Every puppy is raised inside a warm, family environment — never in a kennel. They are handled daily, socialized with gentle children, and accustomed to the sounds and rhythms of a real home.







### Deep Breed Familiarity


With years of focused Chihuahua breeding experience, Alexia understands the breed's unique temperament, health predispositions, and the little quirks that make each puppy special.







### Ongoing New‑Owner Support


The relationship doesn't end at adoption. Alexia provides guidance on feeding, training, and settling in, and she remains a friendly resource for any questions that arise during the transition.

# Privacy Policy



Last Updated:  6/10/2026



Alexia Phipps Chihuahua puppies for adoption ("Company", "we", "our") is committed to protecting your privacy. This privacy policy explains how we collect, use and protect your information when you use our website [business_website] ("Service").


## 1. Information Collection


We may collect the following types of information:


- Personal Information: Name, email address, phone number and address

- Technical Information: IP address, browser type, operating system and website usage data

- Cookies: Information stored on your computer to improve user experience




## 2. Use of Information


We use the collected information for the following purposes:


- Providing requested services

- Improving service and user experience

- Contacting you regarding our services

- Compliance with legal requirements




## 3. Information Sharing


We do not sell, rent or share your personal information with third parties, except in the following cases:


- With your explicit consent

- When required by law

- To protect our rights or user safety

- With service providers who assist in operating the service (under confidentiality agreements)




## 4. User Rights


In accordance with Israeli Privacy Protection Law 1981, you have the following rights:


- Right to access personal information stored about you

- Right to correct inaccurate or incomplete information

- Right to delete personal information in certain circumstances

- Right to object to information processing for marketing purposes

- Right to file a complaint with the Data Protection Authority




## 5. Cookies


Our website uses cookies to improve user experience. You can manage cookies through your browser settings. Disabling cookies may affect website functionality.


## 6. Information Security


We implement reasonable security measures to protect your information, including encryption, firewalls and restricted access control. However, no transmission or storage method is 100% secure.


## 7. Policy Changes


We may update this privacy policy from time to time. Material changes will be posted on the website with 30 days advance notice.

# Accessibility Statement



Last updated:  June 10, 2026



Alexia Phipps Chihuahua puppies for adoption is committed to making our services accessible to all users. We strive to implement the Israeli Standard (TI 5568) based on WCAG 2.1 Level AA guidelines.


Accessibility Level: AA (Israeli Standard TI 5568)



## 1. Accessibility Policy


We believe in equal rights and the right of every person to receive information and services independently and equally. This website was designed and built with special emphasis on accessibility for people with disabilities.


## 2. Accessibility Arrangements on the Site


- Keyboard navigation support

- Screen reader compatibility

- Appropriate color contrast

- Flexible and scalable font sizes

- Descriptive image alt text

- Hierarchical heading structure

- Clear and descriptive links

- Support for 200% zoom without content loss





### WCAG 2.1 Compliance


The website complies with WCAG 2.1 Level AA, which includes:


- Perceivable: Information is presented in ways users can perceive

- Operable: Interface components are operable

- Understandable: Information and user interface are understandable

- Robust: Content can be interpreted by a variety of technologies





## 3. Supported Assistive Technologies


- NVDA (Windows)

- JAWS (Windows)

- VoiceOver (Mac/iOS)

- TalkBack (Android)

- Dragon NaturallySpeaking

- Switch navigation




## 4. Accessibility Testing


The website has been tested using:


- Automated accessibility testing tools

- Manual testing with screen readers

- Keyboard-only navigation

- Color contrast verification

- Testing with users with disabilities




## 5. Continuous Improvements


We are continuously working to improve the accessibility of our website and update it according to technological developments and user feedback.



## 6. Contact and Feedback


If you encounter an accessibility issue on the site or need assistance, please contact us:


- Company: Alexia Phipps Chihuahua puppies for adoption

- Email: alexiaphipps@icloud.com

- Phone: +1 563-484-2927



Response time: We respond to accessibility inquiries within 3 business days and work to resolve issues within 10 business days.
